_comment: Known-stale evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py fails on any report whose recorded input hash no longer matches the committed input ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades one such failure to a loud note -- and only that one: the waiver names the exact report, the exact check, and the exact stale hash. It SELF-EXPIRES: once the evidence is regenerated, the recorded_hash below no longer matches and the checker fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue. Waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call.
